problem.title: Most people have accounts. Very few have a plan.
problem.lead: Advertisers, algorithms and well-meaning friends all have opinions on how you should spend your money. Without a plan of your own, it is easy to end up living someone else's idea of the good life.

items.title: You're on financial autopilot.
items.body: Paychecks come in, bills go out, and the years move fast. You have never sat down and pictured what your best life actually looks like.
items.question: Have you defined what “enough” means for you?

items.title: Your spending doesn't match your priorities.
items.body: Money drifts toward what's urgent instead of what matters. The things you value most keep getting pushed to next year.
items.question: Does your money reflect your values?

items.title: You worry about getting a big decision wrong.
items.body: A home, a business sale, a retirement date. Big choices touch taxes, investments and your estate all at once, and the window to get them right is short.
items.question: Will today's choices still work in ten years?

resolution.title: Clarity, confidence and control.
resolution.body: That's the Everfield difference. We start with your values and vision, then coordinate every part of your financial life around them.

services.title: Everything your money touches, coordinated in one plan.
services.lead: Most families juggle a planner, an investment manager, a tax preparer and an estate attorney who never talk to each other. With Everfield, one team sees the whole picture.

items.title: Financial planning
items.body: A comprehensive plan that connects your cash flow, goals, investments and protection, updated as your life changes.

items.title: Proactive tax planning
items.body: Dedicated tax meetings with your advisor and our CPA partners, plus a complimentary review of your last 3 years of returns.

items.title: Investment management
items.body: Portfolios personalized to your plan and cash flow needs. No generic risk buckets.

items.title: Retirement income
items.body: A sustainable income plan that balances what you need today with growth for the decades ahead.

items.title: Business planning and valuation
items.body: An annual professional valuation of your company, so you can plan growth, succession or a sale with real numbers.

items.title: Estate planning
items.body: Your first estate plan or an update to the one you have. A will and estate plan are included in the membership.

items.title: Insurance review
items.body: A thorough look at your existing policies and real needs, with clear recommendations to protect your family.

items.title: Education and major purchases
items.body: Fund a dream home, a sabbatical or your children's education without putting your long-term goals at risk.

faq.title: Straight answers to fair questions.
faq.lead: Still wondering about something? Ask your advisor on your first call.

items.q: How are you different from every other advisor claiming to be unique?
items.a: We start with your values and vision, not products. Our planning covers every part of your financial life, and our flat-fee structure means we're paid for advice and service, not for selling you anything.

items.q: Isn't “aligning money with values” just marketing?
items.a: No, it's how we actually build plans. We create strategies around your specific life goals rather than generic financial targets, and we revisit them every quarter.

items.q: A flat fee sounds too good to be true. What's the catch?
items.a: There isn't one. Because we charge for planning and service directly through the membership, we can focus on giving you the best advice we can. You never have to move your investments to work with us.

items.q: What credentials do your advisors have?
items.a: Our team includes Certified Financial Planners, CPA partners and licensed insurance specialists, with experience in working with entrepreneurs, digital assets, Medicare and Social Security planning.

items.q: Will I really get time with a senior advisor?
items.a: Yes. Quarterly meetings with your dedicated advisor are the cornerstone of the service, and you have a whole team who knows you and your plan. Members can meet with their advisors as often as they need.

items.q: Will you pressure me to sell my investments and buy your products?
items.a: No. We don't require you to invest with us. Our focus is planning and service, not selling products.

Yes. While it's never required, most of our clients choose to have us manage their investments. We typically charge a flat 0.75% on invested assets and cover all trading fees and expenses (known as a wrap fee). The Everfield advisory fee can range up to 1.25%.

finalCta.title: When did you last update your financial plan?
finalCta.body: Your biggest decisions have a window, and they touch taxes, investments and your estate at once. A 30-minute call is enough to see where you stand.
finalCta.note: Over 1,200 families rely on us to keep their plan current as their lives change.
